  • I am concerned about excessive sweating in my armpits, hands, and feet.
  • I am concerned about excessive sweating in my armpits, hands, and feet.
  • I'm worried about Shishamo's legs
  • I'm worried about my gummy smile
  • Stiff shoulders don't go away even after massage

What is Botox injection? Improve your face size and wrinkles without using a scalpel

This treatment involves injecting Botox, an ingredient extracted from the protein produced by Clostridium botulinum.
By suppressing muscle movement, you can expect to improve facial wrinkles and make your face look smaller by reducing square jaws. It is also effective for improving swollen legs and gummy smiles.
Additionally, by blocking transmission from the sympathetic nerves to the sweat glands, it is possible to reduce the amount of sweat produced in the armpits, hands, and feet.

How long does the effect last?

Although there are individual differences, the effects will begin to appear after 2 to 3 days. After that, it lasts for about 3 to 4 months and disappears after about 6 months.
To maintain the effects, we recommend regular Botox injections.

Application site of Botox injection

  • Areas with wrinkles on the forehead, between the eyebrows, and around the corners of the eyes
  • Ella
  • Shoulders (improvement of stiff shoulders)
  • Armpits, hands, feet (improvement of excessive sweating)
  • Calf (Improvement of shishamo leg)
  • Upper lip (improvement of gummy smile)

Botox side effects, risks and downtime

side effects

  • headache
  • Pain, inflammation, redness, itching, swelling, and bleeding at the injection site
  • allergy

*People who are allergic to Botox cannot receive Botox injections.

risk

  • Lowering of the eyebrows (eyebrow droop)
  • Drooping of the eyelids (ptosis)

downtime

  • You can resume your normal daily activities from the day of your treatment, including washing your face and applying makeup. However, please refrain from vigorously rubbing or massaging the injection site.
  • Internal bleeding may occur at the injection site, but this usually subsides within two weeks.

Clarification of information related to safety in other countries

Please note that as this is an unapproved drug in Japan (not covered by the Pharmaceutical and Medical Devices Act), it may not be eligible for the Relief System for Relief for Adverse Drug Reactions.
If you are aware of the above and wish to use Botox at our hospital, you will be required to sign a consent form proving that you have understood the contents and have undergone the procedure.

About the acquisition route

All Botox drugs used at our hospital are purchased from domestic distributors.
*Reference: Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare's guidance regarding personal imports

https://www.yakubutsu.mhlw.go.jp/individualimport/healthhazard/

Other domestically approved drugs with the same ingredients and efficacy

There are no other domestically approved drugs that have the same ingredients and performance. *This will be a free medical treatment.

Botox injection treatment flow

1Inquiries/Reservations

Please feel free to contact us first and make a reservation.

2counseling

We will check the patient's concerns, symptoms, physical condition, presence of allergies, etc., and determine whether Botox injection is possible.
If you have any concerns, please feel free to ask us anything.

3Botox injection treatment

Botox will be injected into the desired area.

4Go home

You can go home immediately after your treatment. You can immediately resume washing your face and applying makeup.

Precautions when receiving Botox injections

  • After the procedure, be careful not to rub or rub the injection site too hard.
  • Approximately 2 weeks after the treatment, you will come to the hospital to check the condition of the affected area.

Those who cannot receive Botox injections

  • People suffering from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), myasthenia gravis, Lambard-Eaton syndrome, etc.
  • Those who are pregnant, those who may be pregnant, or those who are breastfeeding
  • Those who have had allergic symptoms after previously using Botox Vista®
  • People with chronic respiratory diseases such as asthma
  • People with angle-closure glaucoma
